HtmlDescription:
The Dimension 2 Roof  is sturdy yet flexible enough too withstand any potential abuse. Its corner panels provide additional strength and stability and are rivet-secured. It not only compliments your ATV’s look but protects you from the elements and falling debris.

  • Made of black HMW high density haircell polyethylene 4,7 mm (.187")
  • Cut with superior cnc 5-axis router…all edges are super-smooth
  • Custom bend design for maximum rigidity
  • Extremely durable custom nylon injected clamps
  • All hardware (nuts & bolts) is black-coated finish...no rust!
  • Easy to install: no drilling required
  • Comes complete with all mounting hardware & detailed instructions
